styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Tianyi Pavilion library, old lanes and the riverside Bund.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Seafood, tangyuan dumplings and street snacks.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: Lake views and hill walks outside the city.

stays.why: Central and walkable: near the old library, shopping and metro stops. Good first base.
Riverside walks, historic buildings and evening views. Quieter at night.
Modern district with malls and metro links; good value rooms.
Old streets and local food close by; easy metro access to the centre.

food: Try Ningbo seafood: steamed fish, crab and salted shellfish. Prices vary by season, so ask before ordering.
Ningbo tangyuan (glutinous rice balls in sweet soup) are the city's signature snack; cheap at local shops.
Look for 'Ningbo cuisine' restaurants: fresh, lightly sweet and salty flavours, not heavy spice.
Old Bund and Tianyi Square have many mid-range restaurants; Haishu old streets are better for cheap local eats.
Seafood is sold by weight. Confirm the price per jin (500 g) before it is cooked.
more_time: Add a day for Putuo or the nearby islands by ferry or bus; check schedules on the day.
Swap a city afternoon for a hill or lake walk outside downtown; use a taxi or Didi to get there.
Museum fans can spend a half-day at the Ningbo Museum and nearby parks.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the old library, the Bund and a good seafood meal; add a night for a trip out of town.

month_notes: Coldest month: highs near 11°C, lows near 3°C. Pack a warm coat.
Still cold, highs around 12°C. Few crowds.
Milder at 17°C but wet: about 14 rain days.
Pleasant spring: 21°C highs, 12 rain days. Good walking weather.
Warm and green at 25°C; carry an umbrella (14 rain days).
Warm and wet: 28°C highs, 19 rain days, the wettest month.
Hot and humid: 33°C highs, 26°C lows. Plan indoor sights at midday.
As hot as July, 33°C highs. Stay hydrated.
Still warm at 28°C but rain eases to 15 days.
Best month: 23°C highs, only 10 rain days. Ideal for walking.
Mild at 19°C with 12 rain days. Light layers.
Cool at 12°C highs, 8 rain days. Quiet and cheap.

climate_guide.summary: Humid subtropical: hot, wet summers and cool, drier winters. Spring and autumn are the best times to visit.

items.title: Best time: April, May and October
items.text: Highs of 21–25°C with manageable rain. Good for walking the old streets and the Bund.

items.title: Hot, humid summer (July–August)
items.text: Highs near 33°C and lows near 26°C. Do outdoor sights early or late; rest indoors at midday.

items.title: Rain peaks in June
items.text: About 19 rain days in June and 14 in May. Bring a compact umbrella and waterproof shoes.

items.title: Cool winters (December–February)
items.text: Highs of 11–12°C and lows of 3–4°C. A warm coat and layers are needed, especially by the river.

items.title: Humid most of the year
items.text: Summers feel sticky. Light, breathable clothes help; indoor air-conditioning can feel cold.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers for spring and autumn, a rain jacket, sunscreen and a hat for summer, and a warm coat for winter.

transit.best: Metro for most trips; Didi or Amap for short hops and late nights.

modes.text: Lines 1–5 cover the city. Fares are low and stations are signed in English.
Buses cost ¥1, or ¥2 with air conditioning. Cheap but slower than the metro.
Taxis start at ¥10 for the first 3 km plus ¥2 fuel tax. Didi and Amap work well; Uber does not operate in China.
Not advised for short visits; traffic is dense downtown. Use metro and taxis instead.
Good around Tianyi Square, the Old Bund and old streets. Use metro or a taxi for longer hops.
Bikes can be rented outside downtown; motorbikes are banned in the centre.
